# SmartScope

> > A technical blog focused on AI-assisted development with Claude, GitHub Copilot, and modern agentic AI patterns.

SmartScope provides in-depth guides on AI development workflows, featuring Claude Sonnet 4, MCP (Model Context Protocol), GitHub Copilot integration, and practical implementation patterns for LLM-powered development. The site covers both cutting-edge AI agent architectures and foundational development practices.

## Key Topics

- Claude Sonnet 4
- Claude Opus 4
- GitHub Copilot
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Agentic AI
- Claude Code
- LLM Development
- AI Agent Orchestration
- Code Quality & Refactoring
- Anthropic
- VS Code
- Python & TypeScript
- Automation Workflows
- Video Generation (Veo, Sora)
- Performance Optimization
